personal.p1.modal.desc: Horror Prototype is a solo-developed first-person psychological horror experience built in the Unity engine. The game traps the player in a non-Euclidean home, leveraging atmospheric tension and complex systems for an intense single-player experience.

personal.p2.modal.desc: BitSouls is a solo-developed 2D Action-RPG built in Godot engine, heavily inspired by the Souls-like genre, featuring challenging combat and a distinct pixel-art aesthetic.
personal.p2.modal.contribs:
• check_circleDeveloped core combat system, including hit detection, attack states, and stamina management.

personal.p3.modal.desc: Maskborne is a cooperative, two-player horror puzzle game built solo using Unreal Engine 5. It serves as a proof-of-concept, demonstrating seamless networking and Steam API integration.

• check_circleDeveloped all multiplayer systems, including Steam API connectivity and session management.
